name: Nagano

flag.description: A white disc on an orange field, split by orange curves into the katakana ナ (na).
flag.symbolism: ナ, the first sound of Nagano, is drawn as a bird in flight and as mountains mirrored in a lake; orange is sunlight and white the snow of the "Roof of Japan".

hook: Nagano's white disc on orange is cut into a ナ (na); Fukushima's white emblem on orange is an open ring.
trivia: Nagano borders eight prefectures, more than any other.
The orange of the 1998 Nagano Winter Olympics emblem comes from the flag.
